title: Club Membership: guest pass allowance, overage fee, and guest-per-visit cap
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which Club Membership grants complimentary guest visits each billing cycle, charges for guest visits beyond that allowance, and caps how many guests may accompany the member on one visit.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Complimentary guest visits granted per billing cycle | Fee per guest visit beyond the allowance | Maximum guests on a single visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 0 | $15.00 | 1 |
| Student Metro Access | 0 | $12.00 | 1 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 0 | $15.00 | 1 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 1 | $12.00 | 1 |
| Premier All-Access | 2 | $10.00 | 2 |
| Black Card All-Access | 4 | $0.00 | 3 |
| Founding Legacy Access | 2 | $10.00 | 2 |

## Rule
Each billing cycle, the member's complimentary guest-visit allowance is granted in the tier's own listed amount shown above. A guest visit beyond the member's remaining allowance is charged the tier's own overage fee shown above, instead of being refused. No single visit may bring more guests than the tier's own maximum guests-per-visit figure shown above.

## Eligibility: a guest visit requires an active membership
A guest visit may be recorded only while the membership is active. This check is based on the system's own record of the membership contract's current status, correlated to the specific membership contract the guest visit is recorded against.

## Points of judgement
A member whose remaining guest-pass allowance for the current billing cycle is already exhausted is still permitted the visit; the visit is charged the overage fee rather than turned away. A membership sitting in frozen, past due, or pending-cancellation status is not a case in which a guest visit may be recorded under this basis, since only the active state qualifies.
